appName: Frankenstein VR Story by Mary Shelley
displayName: Frankenstein VR Story by Mary Shelley
display_name: Frankenstein VR Story by Mary Shelley
display_long_description:
This experience brings the atmosphere of a classic slide-show evening into virtual reality. Instead of sitting in front of a wall while someone presents pictures and tells the story, you are surrounded by each scene and guided through it by spoken narration.

Follow Victor Frankenstein from his youth in Geneva to his studies in Ingolstadt, the creation of the Creature, its search for understanding, and the chain of rejection, guilt, and revenge that ends in the frozen Arctic. Stand inside candlelit laboratories, Alpine landscapes, the De Lacey cottage, the Scottish coast, and the ice fields of the North.

Each of the 65 panoramas becomes a place you can explore with your eyes while the narration carries the story forward. You decide when to continue, allowing every scene, voice, and atmosphere to unfold at your own pace.

This is not an action game and not the later Hollywood monster myth. It is a compact, immersive journey through Mary Shelley’s literary original: a story about ambition, responsibility, loneliness, and the consequences of abandoning what we create.

Features include 13 chapters, 65 immersive panoramas, full spoken narration, English and German audio, and stationary viewing without artificial locomotion.
